title: Request for Good Moral Certificate
breadcrumb: [Help Center > Records Registration > Request for Good Moral Certificate]
chunk_text:
[Help Center > Records Registration > Request for Good Moral Certificate]
A Good Moral Certificate is an official document issued by the school certifying that a student has maintained good conduct and moral character during their stay in the institution. This document is commonly required for employment, transfer, scholarship, or other legal and academic purposes.

The certificate is processed by the Helpdesk and is subject to approval by the Prefect of Dicipline before release.

Processing Time

Processing of the Good Moral Certificate takes approximately 1–7 working days, depending on the approval process.

Service Cost & Payment Options

The following processing fee is charged:

- Good Moral Certificate Fee – PhP 100.00

After the request is submitted, the Helpdesk shall bill the student for the applicable fee. Payment may be settled through the following methods:

- Onsite Payment
- Online Payment

Note: Online payments may take 2–5 business days to be reflected in the TO System.

Eligibility

Both old and new students may avail of the service, provided that there is an existing student record in the school.

Requirements:

- Existing student record in the school

When can you avail of the service?

Students may request a Good Moral Certificate at any time, subject to verification and approval.

How to apply for the service?

Step 1

Submit a request for a Good Moral Certificate through the Helpdesk.

Step 2

The Helpdesk verifies the student’s record and processes the request.

Step 3

The request is forwarded to the Prefect of Dicipline for approval.

Step 4

Once approved, the student may claim the document on-site.

Important Note:
The Good Moral Certificate is available for on-site requesting and pickup only. Soft copies are strictly prohibited, as the document is issued on official school letterhead and follows the official template.

Delivery Method

- Pick-up – Students must personally request and claim the document at the designated office.

title: Document Requisition
breadcrumb: [Help Center > Records Registration > Document Requisition]
chunk_text:
[Help Center > Records Registration > Document Requisition]
Allows students and alumni to request official academic documents such as transcripts of records, student permanent records, certificates such as enrollment, honors, ranking, grades, diplomas, and other scholastic academic records. The office also handles record verification/academic record updates.

For document requests, requestors may visit the Registrar’s office from Mondays to Fridays, between 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and on Saturdays from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM, except on declared holidays. The processing time for document requests is 7 working days upon confirmation of payment.

Please note that student clearance is required as part of the processing of student credentials. If not cleared yet, the requested documents will not be processed.

We highly encourage that students should submit their requests in advance, as we receive a high volume of requests. Same-day release of documents is highly discouraged.

Common documents being requested:

- Transcript of Records/TOR (evaluation/informative, board exam, official, etc) - An official document only applicable to college students/alumni containing the student’s complete academic records, subjects taken, and grades earned.
- Certificate of Transfer Credential/Honorable Dismissal – A scholastic record issued to college students only when transferring to another school, certifying that they are officially cleared and permitted to transfer.
- SF10/Student Permanent Record (evaluation/official) - A scholastic record of a student’s academic history used for school evaluation, transfer, or enrollment purposes. Formerly known as F137.
- SF9 / Report Card (CTC/official) - An official document showing the student’s academic performance and grades for a specific academic period or school year. Formerly known as F138.
- Certificates (enrollment, honors and awards, ranking, latin honor, course description etc) -An official statement issued by the Registrar certifying information.
- Certified True Copy (grades, GSA, etc.) - A verified photocopy of an original school document authenticated by the Registrar.
- Diploma - An official document awarded to students upon completion of their academic program, serving as proof of graduation and degree completion.

- Go to the registrar and undergo clearance signing.
- The student must be cleared from the office of the Registrar (no lacking documents), Treasury (no outstanding balances), and from the OSS.
- Students not cleared from the 3 offices will NOT be allowed to go through with their requisition. They must first complete their lacking documents from the registrar and settle any remaining balance at the treasury before being allowed to request the transfer-out documents.
- Students that are cleared will be billed for the requested document and must pay at the treasury office within the day (delay in payment will result in delay of the processing and claiming date).
- Then the document will be processed within 7 working days upon confirmation of payment.
- Upon claiming, the student/representative (with authorization letter) must present their valid ID along with the claim slip.

How to request the documents for Request Credentials (enrolled students in the current term/sem):

- Go to the registrar
- The student must be officially enrolled in the current term/sem to be able to request.
- When confirmed, the student will be billed for the requested document and must pay at the treasury office within the day (delay in payment will result in delay of the processing and claiming date).
- Then the document will be processed within 7 working days upon confirmation of payment.
- Upon claiming, the student/representative (with authorization letter) must present their valid ID along with the claim slip.

- Hand carried by the student/representative

Granting of Degrees and Certificates

A student may be granted a degree and certificate subject to the recommendation of the Dean, Program
Chair and the Faculty Members and confirmed by the Academic Council under the following
conditions:

- A student is eligible to graduate from the certificate or degree program in which he is enrolled, if:
a. all course requirements have been met, provided that at least 60 percent of the total prescribed
units in the curriculum is taken in Mapúa MCM;
all obligations with Mapúa MCM is settled; and no pending disciplinary case or under charges that
could lead to suspension or dismissal with the Office of Student Services.
- A student who is expecting to complete the coursework of his/her program must file an
application for graduation within the prescribed period.
- Eligible graduating student will be endorsed by the College and will be subject to the approval of
the Academic Council, President, and the Board of Trustees.
- Mapúa MCM will confer the academic degrees and certificates through the conduct of a
Commencement Exercise
- Mapúa MCM will grant honorary degrees, distinguished service awards, special medals, and
similar honors or awards to recognize individuals of exceptional accomplishments and
distinctions.
- The College Registrar will keep a permanent record of degrees, certificates, and awards granted
by the institution.
- Students eligible to graduate may opt to defer their graduation rites by informing Mapúa MCM in
writing. The maximum period of deferral is until the next graduation ceremony.
- Students eligible to graduate may choose to graduate in absentia. Students who opt to graduate’
in absentia’ are not permitted to participate in any future ceremony as recipient of the same
certificate or degree.

Graduating students in each baccalaureate program are entitled to LATIN HONORS. The LATIN

What is the role of the Institute for Credentialling Excellence and Lifelong Learning (ICELL)?

The Institute for Credentialing Excellence and Lifelong Learning (ICELL) is the department in charge of providing credentialing opportunities for professionals and students. It supports the institutional objective of producing T-shaped graduates, individuals with a broad range of skills from different areas aside from the specialized area of discipline. The institute, in line with Mapúa Malayan Colleges Mindanao, upholds excellent and relevant education to make its members globally competitive and locally in demand.

What is Micro-Credentialing?

- Micro-Credentialing are earned by completing a single short course or a series of short courses that contain learning activities and assessments on a specific knowledge and skill.
- Micro-Credentialing allows individuals to showcase their achievements and competencies with confidence, as it is verified by reputable organizations.

Micro-Credentials could be:

- Curricular: Classes normally taken and/or are degree requirements for a course of study.
- Co-Curricular: Classes taken in addition to a traditional course of study.

What are the Benefits of Micro-Credentialing?

1. Improves Technical Competencies

- Industry Related Skills. We have identified the most sought knowledge and skills that the industry needs.
- We increased the value of the Mapúa MCM course by integrating Micro credentialing courses.
- The additional learning resources will widen the student’s perspective on the skill studied.

2. Competency Validation

- We equip our students with verifiable certificates and credentials that employers can check.
- These micro-credentialing courses already count as training courses and seminars that they can place in their CVs.

3. Better Job Opportunities or Career Path

- Increased Hiring Potential
- Fresh graduates will already have valid proof for their skills.
- It improves salary and advancements opportunities.

4. Personal Branding

- Being a more credible individual on the field of expertise.
- Better Career Competitiveness.

What is Coursera?

Coursera is an online learning platform that offers a wide range of courses, specializations, and degrees from universities and institutions worldwide. It provides learners flexible access to educational content in various fields, such as technology, business, science, and more.

Mapúa MCM Coursera as a Digital Resource to acquire Micro-Credentials
Mapúa Malayan Colleges Mindanao offered Coursera access to all college students. Starting academic year 2025-2026, Coursera is implemented as a resource and billed in all terms, as stated on ICELL MEMO 002. Unlike the previous academic years where Coursera is only a course requirement. This will provide a wider perspective to the topics in the course to encourage earning certificates as part of the institutions’ objective to equip its students with industry credentials and add more value to the course they are taking.

Primary Features:

- Industry Micro-credentials: Direct access to high-demand Professional Certificates (Google, IBM, Meta, etc.) that are critical for bridging the gap between academic study and in-demand job skills.
- Just-in-Time Learning: Acquire specialized skills (Python, data analytics, UX design, etc.) exactly when you need them for internships, projects, or employment.
- Immediate Readiness: Students can begin upskilling immediately on Day 1 without delays.
- Resource Guarantee: The fixed-fee structure enables the institution to budget and maintain the highest tier of unlimited content access for the entire term.
- Flexibility in Use: Access is available 24/7 throughout the semester for supplemental learning and building your professional portfolio.

Coursera Enrollment - Student

Coursera implementation for 2025-2026 is applied in all terms to encourage earning certificates as part of the Mapúa MCM institution’s objective to equip its students with industry credentials. Coursera is now implemented as a digital learning resource, unlike the previous school years where Coursera is only a course requirement as stated in ICELL Memo 002. This was This initiative commenced in the first term of the 2025-2026 academic year.

Processing the Coursera enrollment takes about 3 to 5 minutes.
